import svgwrite

OUT = ""
W, H = 960, 500
ML, MT, MR, MB = 80, 60, 40, 70
PW = W - ML - MR
PH = H - MT - MB
NAVY = "#1F4E79"; BLUE = "#2E86AB"; BLUE_L1 = "#7FA8C9"; BLUE_L2 = "#B7CFE0"
RED = "#E63946"; GREEN = "#2A9D8F"; AMBER = "#E9C46A"; ORANGE = "#E76F51"
GRAY = "#6B7280"; GRID = "#D8DEE4"; DARK = "#1F2D3D"

def base(title, subtitle, fname):
    dwg = svgwrite.Drawing(filename=OUT + fname, size=(W, H))
    dwg.add(dwg.rect(insert=(0, 0), size=(W, H), fill="#FFFFFF"))
    dwg.add(dwg.text(title, insert=(W / 2, 32), font_size=19, font_weight="bold",
                     text_anchor="middle", fill=DARK, font_family="Arial"))
    dwg.add(dwg.text(subtitle, insert=(W / 2, 52), font_size=12.5,
                     text_anchor="middle", fill=GRAY, font_family="Arial"))
    return dwg

def ypx(v, ymin, ymax): return MT + (1 - (v - ymin) / (ymax - ymin)) * PH
def xpx(i, n): return ML + (i / (n - 1)) * PW if n > 1 else ML + PW / 2

def gridlines(dwg, ymin, ymax, step, fmt="{:.0f}"):
    v = ymin
    while v <= ymax + 1e-9:
        y = ypx(v, ymin, ymax)
        dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(ML, y), end=(W - MR, y), stroke=GRID, stroke_width=1))
        dwg.add(dwg.text(fmt.format(v), insert=(ML - 10, y + 4), font_size=11,
                         fill=GRAY, text_anchor="end", font_family="Arial"))
        v += step

def xlabels(dwg, labels, yoffset=0):
    n = len(labels)
    for i, lab in enumerate(labels):
        x = xpx(i, n)
        dwg.add(dwg.text(str(lab), insert=(x, H - MB + 22 + yoffset), font_size=12,
                         fill=DARK, text_anchor="middle", font_family="Arial"))

# Chart 1: EU inflation vs growth
def chart1():
    years = [2022, 2023, 2024]; infl = [9.2, 6.4, 2.4]; growth = [3.4, 0.4, 0.9]
    ymin, ymax, step = -1.0, 10.0, 2.0
    dwg = base("The Great Disinflation: EU Inflation vs. GDP Growth (2022-2024)",
               "EU-27 total. Inflation fell from a 9.2% energy-shock peak back to target while growth stabilised.",
               "chart1_eu_dis_inflation.svg")
    gridlines(dwg, ymin, ymax, step)
    yt = ypx(2.0, ymin, ymax)
    dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(ML, yt), end=(W - MR, yt), stroke=GREEN, stroke_width=2, stroke_dasharray="7,5"))
    dwg.add(dwg.text("ECB 2% target", insert=(W - MR - 4, yt - 7), font_size=11, fill=GREEN,
                     text_anchor="end", font_family="Arial", font_weight="bold"))
    pts = [(xpx(i, 3), ypx(v, ymin, ymax)) for i, v in enumerate(infl)]
    dwg.add(dwg.path(d="M " + " L ".join(f"{p[0]:.1f},{p[1]:.1f}" for p in pts), fill="none", stroke=RED, stroke_width=3.5))
    for p, v in zip(pts, infl):
        dwg.add(dwg.circle(center=p, r=6, fill=RED))
        dwg.add(dwg.text(f"{v:.1f}%", insert=(p[0], p[1] - 14), font_size=12, fill=RED,
                         text_anchor="middle", font_family="Arial", font_weight="bold"))
    pts2 = [(xpx(i, 3), ypx(v, ymin, ymax)) for i, v in enumerate(growth)]
    dwg.add(dwg.path(d="M " + " L ".join(f"{p[0]:.1f},{p[1]:.1f}" for p in pts2), fill="none", stroke=BLUE, stroke_width=3.5))
    for p, v in zip(pts2, growth):
        dwg.add(dwg.circle(center=p, r=6, fill=BLUE))
        dwg.add(dwg.text(f"{v:.1f}%", insert=(p[0], p[1] + 22), font_size=12, fill=BLUE,
                         text_anchor="middle", font_family="Arial", font_weight="bold"))
    a1 = (xpx(0, 3), ypx(9.2, ymin, ymax))
    dwg.add(dwg.text("Peak: 2022 energy shock", insert=(a1[0] - 118, a1[1] - 28), font_size=11.5, fill=DARK, font_family="Arial"))
    dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(a1[0] - 8, a1[1] - 8), end=(a1[0] - 100, a1[1] - 22), stroke=GRAY, stroke_width=1))
    a2 = (xpx(2, 3), ypx(2.4, ymin, ymax))
    dwg.add(dwg.text("Back to target: 2.4%", insert=(a2[0] + 110, a2[1] - 30), font_size=11.5, fill=RED,
                     font_family="Arial", font_weight="bold"))
    dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(a2[0] + 10, a2[1] - 8), end=(a2[0] + 90, a2[1] - 22), stroke=GRAY, stroke_width=1))
    a3 = (xpx(1, 3), ypx(0.4, ymin, ymax))
    dwg.add(dwg.text("Growth stalls at 0.4% (2023)", insert=(a3[0] + 150, a3[1] - 12), font_size=11.5,
                     fill=BLUE, font_family="Arial", font_weight="bold"))
    dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(a3[0] + 12, a3[1] - 4), end=(a3[0] + 90, a3[1] - 12), stroke=GRAY, stroke_width=1))
    dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(ML + 30, H - MB + 44), end=(ML + 60, H - MB + 44), stroke=RED, stroke_width=3))
    dwg.add(dwg.text("Inflation (CPI)", insert=(ML + 68, H - MB + 48), font_size=12, fill=DARK, font_family="Arial"))
    dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(ML + 175, H - MB + 44), end=(ML + 205, H - MB + 44), stroke=BLUE, stroke_width=3))
    dwg.add(dwg.text("GDP growth", insert=(ML + 213, H - MB + 48), font_size=12, fill=DARK, font_family="Arial"))
    xlabels(dwg, years)
    dwg.save()

# Chart 2: GDP growth by country
def chart2():
    countries = ["Germany", "France", "Italy", "Spain", "Netherlands", "Poland", "Sweden"]
    g22 = [1.8, 2.5, 3.7, 5.8, 4.3, 5.1, 2.6]
    g23 = [0.0, 0.7, 0.7, 2.5, 0.1, 0.2, -0.2]
    g24 = [-0.3, 0.9, 0.5, 3.2, 0.7, 3.0, 0.8]
    ymin, ymax, step = -1.5, 7.0, 1.0
    colors = [BLUE_L2, BLUE_L1, BLUE]; years = ["2022", "2023", "2024"]
    dwg = base("GDP Growth by Country: The 2022 Rebound Fades Into a Two-Speed Europe",
               "Real GDP growth (%). Only Spain and Poland grew above 3% in 2024; Germany slipped into recession.",
               "chart2_growth_by_country.svg")
    gridlines(dwg, ymin, ymax, step)
    y0 = ypx(0, ymin, ymax)
    dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(ML, y0), end=(W - MR, y0), stroke="#9AA7B4", stroke_width=1.4))
    n = len(countries); gw = PW / n; bw = gw * 0.24
    for ci in range(n):
        cx = ML + gw * ci + gw / 2
        for yi, vals in enumerate([g22, g23, g24]):
            v = vals[ci]
            col = RED if v < 0 else colors[yi]
            h = abs(v) / (ymax - ymin) * PH
            y = ypx(max(v, 0), ymin, ymax)
            x = cx - bw * 1.5 + yi * bw
            dwg.add(dwg.rect(insert=(x, y), size=(bw - 3, h), fill=col))
            if v != 0:
                lbl_y = y - 6 if v > 0 else y + 16
                dwg.add(dwg.text(f"{v:.1f}", insert=(x + (bw - 3) / 2, lbl_y), font_size=9.5,
                                 fill=DARK, text_anchor="middle", font_family="Arial"))
    xlabels(dwg, countries, yoffset=6)
    for i, (lab, col) in enumerate(zip(years, colors)):
        x0 = ML + 360 + i * 130
        dwg.add(dwg.rect(insert=(x0, H - MB + 40), size=(16, 12), fill=col))
        dwg.add(dwg.text(lab, insert=(x0 + 22, H - MB + 51), font_size=12, fill=DARK, font_family="Arial"))
    dwg.add(dwg.rect(insert=(ML + 360 + 3 * 130, H - MB + 40), size=(16, 12), fill=RED))
    dwg.add(dwg.text("Negative", insert=(ML + 360 + 3 * 130 + 22, H - MB + 51), font_size=12, fill=DARK, font_family="Arial"))
    dwg.save()

# Chart 3: Trade balance
def chart3():
    countries = ["Germany", "France", "Italy", "Spain", "Netherlands", "Poland", "Sweden", "EU-27"]
    t22 = [-84.3, -163.6, -0.8, -69.4, 78.2, -16.2, 33.1, -198.4]
    t24 = [-15.8, -84.2, 42.6, -24.3, 79.1, -8.9, 28.5, -8.3]
    ymin, ymax, step = -230.0, 120.0, 50.0
    dwg = base("Trade Rebalancing: EU Deficit Shrinks 96% While Italy Turns Surplus",
               "Trade balance (bn EUR). The EU-27 deficit fell from -198.4bn to -8.3bn between 2022 and 2024.",
               "chart3_trade_balance.svg")
    gridlines(dwg, ymin, ymax, step)
    y0 = ypx(0, ymin, ymax)
    dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(ML, y0), end=(W - MR, y0), stroke="#9AA7B4", stroke_width=1.4))
    n = len(countries); gw = PW / n; bw = gw * 0.30
    for ci in range(n):
        cx = ML + gw * ci + gw / 2
        for yi, vals in enumerate([t22, t24]):
            v = vals[ci]
            col = RED if v < 0 else GREEN
            h = abs(v) / (ymax - ymin) * PH
            y = ypx(max(v, 0), ymin, ymax)
            x = cx - bw / 2 + (yi - 0.5) * bw * 1.1 + bw * 0.2
            dwg.add(dwg.rect(insert=(x, y), size=(bw - 4, h), fill=col, opacity=0.9 if yi == 1 else 0.55))
            lbl_y = y - 7 if v >= 0 else y + 17
            if abs(v) > 5:
                dwg.add(dwg.text(f"{v:.0f}", insert=(x + (bw - 4) / 2, lbl_y), font_size=9,
                                 fill=DARK, text_anchor="middle", font_family="Arial"))
    xlabels(dwg, countries, yoffset=4)
    dwg.add(dwg.rect(insert=(ML + 300, H - MB + 40), size=(16, 12), fill=RED, opacity=0.55))
    dwg.add(dwg.text("2022", insert=(ML + 322, H - MB + 51), font_size=12, fill=DARK, font_family="Arial"))
    dwg.add(dwg.rect(insert=(ML + 380, H - MB + 40), size=(16, 12), fill=GREEN))
    dwg.add(dwg.text("2024", insert=(ML + 402, H - MB + 51), font_size=12, fill=DARK, font_family="Arial"))
    dwg.save()

# Chart 4: Public debt 2024
def chart4():
    items = [("Sweden", 33.4), ("Netherlands", 44.2), ("Poland", 51.3), ("Germany", 62.9),
             ("Spain", 104.3), ("France", 112.0), ("Italy", 134.8)]
    xmax = 150.0
    dwg = base("Public Debt 2024: The North Is Lean, the South Is Loaded",
               "General government debt (% of GDP). EU-27 average: 80.1%. Countries above the line carry over 100% of GDP in debt.",
               "chart4_public_debt.svg")
    dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(ML, MT), end=(ML, H - MB), stroke=GRID, stroke_width=1))
    def xp(v): return ML + v / xmax * PW
    xa = xp(80.1)
    dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(xa, MT - 6), end=(xa, H - MB), stroke=NAVY, stroke_width=2, stroke_dasharray="8,5"))
    dwg.add(dwg.text("EU avg 80.1%", insert=(xa, MT - 12), font_size=11, fill=NAVY,
                     text_anchor="middle", font_family="Arial", font_weight="bold"))
    n = len(items); bh = PH / n * 0.55
    for i, (name, v) in enumerate(items):
        y = MT + i * (PH / n) + (PH / n - bh) / 2
        col = GREEN if v < 60 else (AMBER if v < 100 else ORANGE)
        bwv = xp(v) - ML
        dwg.add(dwg.rect(insert=(ML, y), size=(bwv, bh), fill=col))
        dwg.add(dwg.text(name, insert=(ML - 10, y + bh / 2 + 4), font_size=13, fill=DARK,
                         text_anchor="end", font_family="Arial"))
        dwg.add(dwg.text(f"{v:.1f}%", insert=(ML + bwv + 10, y + bh / 2 + 4), font_size=13,
                         fill=DARK, font_family="Arial", font_weight="bold"))
    for v in range(0, 151, 30):
        x = xp(v)
        dwg.add(dwg.line(start=(x, H - MB), end=(x, H - MB + 6), stroke=GRAY, stroke_width=1))
        dwg.add(dwg.text(f"{v}", insert=(x, H - MB + 22), font_size=11, fill=GRAY,
                         text_anchor="middle", font_family="Arial"))
    for i, (lab, col) in enumerate([("<60% healthy", GREEN), ("60-100% moderate", AMBER), (">100% elevated", ORANGE)]):
        x0 = ML + 220 + i * 200
        dwg.add(dwg.rect(insert=(x0, H - MB + 40), size=(16, 12), fill=col))
        dwg.add(dwg.text(lab, insert=(x0 + 22, H - MB + 51), font_size=12, fill=DARK, font_family="Arial"))
    dwg.save()

chart1(); chart2(); chart3(); chart4()
print("done")
